description: Ministry of Sports - Order to amend the Ex. Gaz. No. 1990/23 of 27.10.2016 adding  " 63. Muay Thai " to the Schedule II
reasoning: This gazette content contains an order made by the Minister of Sports under Section 28 of the Sports Act, No. 25 of 1973, which involves regulatory matters and legal authority. It amends a previous order by adding a new sport (Muay Thai) to Schedule II of the Act. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory modifications under existing legislation.
